subject: Post-demo: resilience test matrix & failover behavior questions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@calixa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: resilience test matrix & failover behavior questions

Alex — great demo earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we saw
- Live inference on your R&D workload (short chat + multi-turn prompts) looked good; tail latency under light load was ~30–50ms.
- A couple of open points around cross-region failover and rate-limit behavior when you hit tenant quotas.

What we recommend for direct comparison vs hyperscalers and internal API variants
1) Controlled saturation (rate-limit stress): ramp from 100 qps -> 2k qps over 10m to observe throttling behaviors and 429 patterns.
2) KV/prefix cache persistence across failover: warm cache, then simulate node/region failover and measure cold-start penalty.
3) Error-budget burn tests: induce transient network errors and verify automatic fallback latency and success rates.
4) Region failover (us-west -> eu-west): measure request routing time and session continuity.
5) Quantized model vs full fp16 latency and correctness under burst.

I've attached a short probe plan (redwood-resilience-probe-plan.pdf) that maps each test to metrics we care about (p95/p99 latency, 429 rates, success ratio, error budget delta). Can you confirm Calixa resources for these tests (engineers + service accounts) and any constraints we should know about?

Proposed timing: preliminary throttle probe Monday 2027-04-26, full run Wed 2027-04-28 (morning PT). If that works, we can lock a 2‑hour window and Marissa will own the test run & data collection.

Next asks from our side
- Confirm the token/throughput quota for the test project and whether you want us to hit your Bedrock/GCP endpoints too for a straight compare (we can test Redwood hosted vs Bedrock + GCP AI Platform).
- Any security/process gating (procurement/ACLs) we should coordinate ahead of time?

Thanks — I’ll stand up a test harness and populate the SLO comparison template once we agree scope.

—Ben
